name: singlet_ingest_quant_umi_deduplication
title: UMI deduplication and molecule collapsing
description: Collapses UMI-tagged reads into molecule counts per cell and feature, merging sequencing-error UMIs into their parent molecule and keeping distinct molecules apart. Use it after read-to-gene mapping and whitelist correction, when a read table with corrected barcodes, UMIs and class ids exists; the default directional_umitools method suits single-gene groups, and cr_like_em or parsimony_em resolve multi-gene classes. Do not use it to assign ambiguous reads to genes, or to re-collapse counts that an engine already collapsed unless the purpose is comparing collapse rules.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

parse_stream.description: Read table path or URI with one row per read: corrected cell barcode, packed UMI, class id and read count.

method.description: Collapse rule. directional_umitools is the default for single-gene groups; the -em modes resolve multi-gene classes.

umi_length.description: UMI length in bases; null reads it from uns/ingest_geometry.

umi_edit_distance.description: Maximum UMI Hamming distance; null uses the method default (0 for cr_like modes, 1 otherwise). Ignored by nodedup.

write_read_to_molecule.description: Also write per-read molecule assignments to uns/umi_read_to_molecule; large, so off by default.

count_ratio_factor.description: Parent-to-child count ratio kappa; the offset is fixed by method (1 for UMI-tools, 0 for strict).

alevin_fry.description: Options for the alevin-fry modes cr_like, cr_like_em, parsimony and parsimony_em.

large_graph_threshold.description: Node count above which parsimony modes switch strategy; null uses 1000 for parsimony modes.

em_max_iter.description: Maximum EM iterations for the -em modes (singlet-proposed default).

em_tolerance.description: EM convergence tolerance on the change in molecule counts (singlet-proposed default).

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/counts_molecules. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs. Keys: method, umi_length, n_cells, n_molecules, reads_per_molecule_median, merged_umi_fraction. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
